spec.title: Enforce AskUserQuestion tool for Q&A dialogue steps
spec.context:
The conduct_qa_dialogue step in festina-scope and festina-create has vague instructions that allow the LLM to output questions as text instead of using the AskUserQuestion tool, and to ask multiple questions at once instead of one at a time. This results in poor UX where the user sees a wall of technical questions dumped as text without the ability to respond interactively.
Working patterns exist in festina-map-engineering (line 213) and festina-define-product (line 109) that explicitly enforce "one question at a time" using the AskUserQuestion tool.

in-scope.item: Refactor festina-scope conduct_qa_dialogue to use explicit AskUserQuestion blocks
Refactor festina-create conduct_qa_dialogue to use "propose first, then validate" pattern
Add "one question at a time" note to both skills
Replace output-based confirmation with proper AskUserQuestion confirmation
Include "You decide" options in festina-create for LLM inference

out-of-scope.item: Changes to other skills (festina-plan, festina-implement, etc.)
Changes to the AskUserQuestion tool itself
Adding new features to the Q&A dialogue beyond enforcing proper tool usage

requirements.requirement: festina-scope conduct_qa_dialogue MUST include the note: "Use AskUserQuestion tool for **one question at a time**."
festina-scope MUST use explicit <action>Use AskUserQuestion tool with:</action> blocks for all questions
festina-scope question categories: Approach, Files, Dependencies, Patterns, Constraints, Confirmation
festina-create conduct_qa_dialogue MUST include the note: "Use AskUserQuestion tool for **one question at a time**."
festina-create MUST follow "propose first, then validate" pattern - LLM proposes understanding, user validates
festina-create validation questions MUST include "You decide" option for LLM inference
When user selects "You decide", LLM uses judgment to fill gaps (research if helpful, infer from context)
Both skills MUST replace <output> confirmation blocks with proper AskUserQuestion confirmation
Both skills MUST preserve existing functionality (web research triggers, user volunteering info, research branches)
Each AskUserQuestion block MUST be followed by <note>User can select "Other" to...</note>

patterns.pattern: Each question uses full action block with header, question, options (2-4), multiSelect. Followed by note explaining "Other" option behavior.
Related questions grouped in <questions name="..."> elements for organization.
LLM proposes understanding based on analysis, user validates with Yes/Partly/No options.
